runtime: Chromium software WebGL2 via ANGLE SwiftShader
initialization: Stop renderer animation loop; ordinary game.start(); 30 updatePlaying(1/120) and updateVisuals(1/120,1) steps; no later simulation or visual update.

cameraPath.type: small lateral camera-only pan, smoothstep poses

captureMethod: game/scripts/qa-browser-capture.mjs canvasOnly actual WebGL2 pixel-pack buffer; bounded enqueue 60s, fence 60s, copy 60s. Stop after first failed capture.
limitations: Diagnostic camera-only inspection, not gameplay footage.
2 FPS is the authored capture cadence, not measured game or hardware FPS.
Software WebGL does not validate physical-device performance.
Six sampled camera poses are encoded directly; no interpolated or generated scene images.
Actual canvas capture excludes HTML overlays.
Gameplay and visual simulation are fixed after the initial 30 steps; this does not inspect actor animation, route completion, dynamic gameplay or cameraRig behavior.
Baseline dist does not contain build-info.json; source attribution must be read together with recorded frozen-tree provenance.
A 2 FPS sequence is a six-pose camera-path inspection and may appear stepped; it cannot establish temporal smoothness at a gameplay frame rate.
Natural pre-freeze visual clock differs by 0.0000 ms across the two runs; visual clocks remain fixed within each pan and were not overridden.
The final specified camera pose is dominated by a nearby wall/panel in both builds; visibility of the wider scene is limited. The requested camera path was not changed to improve framing.

buildInfo.verificationScope: Exact source and package; source, campaign, production WebGL, UI and continuous video gate publication

proof.method: Every GitHub tracked blob independently hashed from game source bytes

before.distAttribution: Root confirmed this frozen game/dist was built from the verified baseline tree; exact served dist tree is independently SHA256 recorded.

after.sourceTreeAttribution: Root confirmed frozen art source bytes match the exact 14c commit tree; local HEAD attribution is not used as artifact identity.

captureSessionNotes: One independent level41 capture session; stop on first failure, no recapture. Per-frame metadata and report checkpoints are fsynced. Browser and HTTP server are created by the same Node process within one exec network/PID namespace.

preStartVisualClockDifference.note: Normal ready-state render loops before the requested freeze may leave slightly different visual clocks. No clock or game state override was used. Each build remains fixed throughout its camera pan.

imageComparison.scope: JPEG RGB difference verifies images differ; this metric does not determine artistic quality.
visualObservations: The first specified camera pose shows stair surfaces and overhead support beams in both builds; AFTER has visibly lighter stair/wall surfaces and cooler beam surfaces.
The final specified camera pose is dominated by a nearby wall/panel in both builds, limiting visible scene detail; the actual images are valid nonblank WebGL captures.
The six recorded camera positions change; gameplay and visual simulation remain fixed after the initial 30 steps.

video.title: before / after, camera inspection
video.composition: Each output frame horizontally stacks the same-index actual before and after JPEG; title panel added outside the scene. No temporal interpolation, invented scene frames or gameplay advancement.
video.visualQA: First and last encoded output frames inspected: readable labels and two aligned panels, no blank image or dropped panel. Final pose has foreground wall/panel occlusion as recorded in limitations.
video.encoding: ffmpeg libx264 crf18 yuv420p; six frames at 2FPS; no audio

independentHarnessReview.scope: Read-only review of private harness, helper identity, requested camera and initialization commands, bounded serial captures, fsync checkpoints and source provenance.
independentHarnessReview.additionalReportAssertion: Requested level41 is explicitly checked as levelIndex40 in both initialization proofs and every raw capture proof.
